newsitem.title: CANADA: Protectionism growing in G7 nations, poll shows.
newsitem.headline: Protectionism growing in G7 nations, poll shows.

text.p: A majority of people in Group of Seven industrialized nations (G7) now see protectionism rather than expanded trade as the best route to national prosperity, an international survey released on Friday by a Canadian polling group showed.

The Angus Reid poll, released on the day G7 leaders and Russian President Boris Yeltsin met in Denver for the first day of the annual summit of industrialized nations, showed a strong tide of protectionism in five of the seven G7 nations.
A majority of the respondents in the United States, Great Britain, Italy and France favored protectionist policies.
